caption_L1: Main export partners of Sweden in 2019 , by export value (in million SEK) is a bar plot. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 150,000 along the x-axis, marked Export value in million SEK. caption_L2L3: Norway is the main export partner of Sweden closely followed by Germany. Turkey, Korea and Austria had very low export values. A countries proximity to Sweden does not seem to directly affect its export value.
